notes: The lamed of s016 carries the appositional even; the alternative of marking it unrepresented and the even added was available, but a morpheme stands in the phrase for the word (rules 11, 30).
'heave offerings' and 'hallowed things' both head on the lexeme-bearing word rather than the supplied generic noun (rule 31).
The two datives of 'given thee' and 'by reason of the anointing' are handled differently on purpose: s010 is a bare indirect object (rule 40), s025 a fixed phrase headed on reason (rule 24).
